brand.name: PrepAI
brand.notes: The `heart` is the brand mark — a heart shape representing wellness and health intelligence. The `bars` (two vertical rectangles on the left) suggest health monitoring/metrics. The `pulse` is an ECG-style zigzag line running through the heart, evoking vital signs and real-time health tracking. Animations should read as 'monitor → analyze → empower' — the heart is the container, the pulse is the data, and the bars are the quantified insight.

defs:
<defs>
    <linearGradient id="brandGradient" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#11518F"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#08B8AE"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <radialGradient id="bgGlow" cx="0.5" cy="0.38" r="0.62">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#142240"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#0a1628"/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>

layers.markup:
<g id="background" data-layer="background" data-role="backdrop">
    <rect x="0" y="0" width="1080" height="720" fill="url(#bgGlow)"/>
  </g>

<g id="mark" data-layer="mark" data-role="letterform"
     transform="translate(231, -5) scale(2.5)">

    
    <path id="heart-path"
          fill="none" stroke="url(#brandGradient)" stroke-width="11"
          stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"
          d="M128 226 C111 209 52 161 34 113 C18 71 43 36 79 34 C101 33 117 47 128 64 C139 47 155 33 177 34 C213 36 238 71 222 113 C204 161 145 209 128 226"/>

    
    <rect id="bar-short" x="9" y="106" width="13" height="45" rx="4"
          fill="url(#brandGradient)" stroke="none"/>
    <rect id="bar-tall"  x="28" y="95" width="16" height="67" rx="4"
          fill="url(#brandGradient)" stroke="none"/>

    
    <path id="pulse-path"
          fill="none" stroke="url(#brandGradient)" stroke-width="11"
          stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"
          d="M44 128 H84 L93 128 L101 116 L111 143 L123 83 L136 169 L148 118 L158 128 H209"/>
  </g>

<g id="wordmark" data-layer="wordmark" data-role="text"
     data-text="prepai" data-center-x="540" data-baseline-y="640"
     data-font-size="96" data-fill="#ffffff">
    <text x="540" y="640"
          fill="#ffffff"
          font-family="Inter, -apple-system, sans-serif"
          font-size="96"
          font-weight="300"
          letter-spacing="-3"
          text-anchor="middle">prepai</text>
  </g>
